SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-10-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-10-2022 BY JUDGE PRO TEM MICHELE MCGILL. PLAINTIFF JOANNA ELIZABETH FIGUEROA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT TOP BEEF, LLC DBA NIKU STEAKHOUSE IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY VERONICA RIVAS, HR DIRECTOR. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: MICHELE MCGILL; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-10-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FIGUEROA, JOANNA ELIZABETH IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT TOP BEEF, LLC DBA NIKU STEAKHOUSE THE DELAY IN PROVIDING RECORDS WS JUSTIFIED DUE TO MULTIPLE EMPLOYEES TESTING POSITIVE FOR COVID-19. THE DELAY WAS SHORT. PLAINTIFF'S EMPLOYMENT WAS "AT WILL" SO EMPLOYER HAD DISCRETION TO DISCHARGE PLAINTIFF. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
